model_rule: .converge/playbooks/ is source blueprint; .converge/journal/ is executable run state/evidence. Fix source or loader/compiler behavior; do not hand-edit manifest.json or runstate.json.

findings.gap: syncPlaybookToJournal copies playbook source files (playbook.yml, TASK.md, scripts) into the journal directory, erasing the blueprint/runtime distinction. The journal becomes a mirror of source code, not just runtime evidence. The comment at line 215-217 confirms this is by design: 'After syncing, the journal can serve as the single source of truth for task definitions AND runtime state.'
findings.evidence: sync.ts L215-217: comment says journal is 'single source of truth for task definitions AND runtime state'. L219-232: function copies files from playbookDir into journalDir. L248-287: syncDir iterates playbook entries and copies each into the journal.
findings.correction: Remove source-file mirroring from the sync. Keep only true runtime artifacts in the journal (runstate.json, manifest.json, events.jsonl, attempts/, logs). The playbook directory should remain the single source for task definitions.
findings.test_to_write: tests/playbook-journal-separation.test.ts: test that syncPlaybookToJournal does NOT copy playbook source files (TASK.md, playbook.yml) into the journal directory.

findings.gap: Every state-touching CLI command triggers syncAllPlaybooks, mirroring the entire playbook source tree into the journal on each invocation. The boundary between blueprint and runtime dissolves at every command boundary.
findings.evidence: main.ts L411-427: SYNC_COMMANDS includes 11 commands (run, status, tree, show, inspect, verify, metrics, benchmark, next, step, playbook). L424-432: on each, syncAllPlaybooks is called.
findings.correction: Limit sync to execution commands (run, compile) only. Status/inspection commands should read the playbook or pre-compiled manifest directly without re-syncing.
findings.test_to_write: tests/cli-no-sync-on-read.test.ts: test that converge tree, converge inspect, converge status do NOT trigger playbook sync.

findings.gap: The converge journal command reads from .converge/target/ but compile and run write to .converge/journal/. These are different directories, so the journal command cannot find runtime state produced by converge run or converge compile.
findings.evidence: commands-journal.ts L30: join(projectDir, '.converge', 'target'). commands-compile.ts L182: join(projectRoot, '.converge', 'journal', playbookName). journal/structure.ts L82: join(projectDir, '.converge', 'journal', name). Three different conventions coexist.
findings.correction: Unify on .converge/journal/{playbook}/ as the single runtime target. Remove .converge/target/ usage from commands-journal.ts.
findings.test_to_write: tests/journal-command-path.test.ts: test that converge journal reads runstate from the same directory that converge compile writes to.
